A '''battle droid''' served under the command of a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Desix)|tactical droid]] and [[Governor]] [[Tawni Ames]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Solitary" />

==Biography==
During [[mission to Desix]], this [[OOM command battle droid]] commanded an [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|AAT tank]] that managed to shoot down an [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|Imperial shuttle]]. After the [[Imperial Shuttle 995|shuttle]] crashed, [[Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody|CC-2224]] and [[Crosshair and Cody's team|his squad]] distracted the [[tank]] from [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] so he could hit the tank's weak spot, destroying the commander and the rest of their force.<ref name="Solitary" />
